problems.what: no instant certainty; the triage (medical danger, environment, body, overload, how open the mind is); the steps; don't deepen, hunt for hidden truth or debate what it is
problems.replace: you check in with the room, your body, and safety in general.
problems.with: you check in with the room, your body, and safety in general, without rewarding it with instant certainty about what it is. Run the triage first: medical danger, environment, body, overload, and how open your mind has become. Open your eyes, feel your feet, name the room, lower the stimulation, leave hostile company, and stop adding prompts. Don’t go deeper, hunt for hidden truth, or debate what it is while you’re destabilized.

problems.what: the script invited the presence forward and had the body bring it to safety; the published: only what can be integrated is welcome, too much can wait, the adult remains, the body may return to safety
problems.replace: “If there is anything that can be integrated right now, you may come forward. But know that you can wait, and that you will not be able to come forward until you are something that can be integrated. problems.with: “Only what can be integrated is welcome right now. Anything that’s too much can wait. The adult in me is still here, and my body can go back to safety.”

Again, it doesn’t matter whether or not it’s literally a demon; this isn’t a test of what it is. Put your hand on your heart, if that feels welcome, take a comfortable breath, and keep the room available.
